parameter_semantics: destination_field selects the calibrated observed blue_goal point in world metres. It is resolved from the causal current observation at every replan and frozen only for that execution chunk; it is not an arbitrary coordinate or actuator input.
output_semantics: Each slot is [TCP position offset from causal chunk blue_goal in metres (3), world rotation 6-D (6), gripper scalar (1)]. The destination frame is world aligned and translated to the observed blue_goal. Slot 0 represents t-1 and execution uses slots 1..8 for t..t+7. decode_action adds the frozen destination, Gram-Schmidt projects rotation to SO(3) with a finite degeneracy fallback, and invokes panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints.

conversion_check.description: Compare decoded FK TCP position, rotation angle and gripper scalar to each demonstrated commanded TCP target. Destination subtraction/addition and 6-D label conversion preserve commanded poses; nonunique IK joints are allowed.

cut_relation: Every action in all twelve assigned [600,stop) segments is supervised, retaining the full [600,850) red_transfer overlap before the destination-specialized insertion portion.
